title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 7:24-27
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 7:24-27</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="24" /> So then, <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">everyone who hears these words of mine</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and does them, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">they will be like a</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">wise</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">man</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">who built his house on the</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">rock</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="25" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">and the rain came down</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">and the rivers came</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">and the winds blew</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">and they fell upon that house</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C" type="secondary">
        <group>
          but it did not fall, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">because its foundation was on the rock</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="26" /> And <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">everyone who hears these words of mine</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and does not do them, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">they will be like a</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">foolish</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">man</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">who built his house on the</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">sand</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="27" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">and the rain came down</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">and the rivers came</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">and the winds blew</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">and they fell upon that house</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          and it fell, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and its falling was huge.
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
